title: Availability-Aware Historical Feedback Learning for Electric Arc Furnace Temperature and Chemical Composition Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.17463v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electric arc furnace (EAF) steelmaking plays an increasingly important role in recycled and lower-carbon steel production. However, variability in charged materials, energy input, and operating conditions makes accurate prediction of molten steel temperature and final chemical composition challenging. Intermittent or delayed measurements limit the information available for timely prediction. This study develops an availability-aware historical-feedback learning framework for predicting EAF endpoint temperature and the final concentrations of twelve chemical elements. Eight industrial data sources are integrated into three progressively enriched predictor representations comprising 19 static, 39 temporal, and 47 history-informed features. Historical outcomes are incorporated only when eligible under an assumed 60-minute measurement-release delay. Using 19,738 temperature heats and 3,341 chemistry heats, twelve tuned regression algorithms

translated_title: 面向电弧炉温度与化学成分预测的可用性感知历史反馈学习方法
translated_abstract: 电弧炉（EAF）炼钢在再生钢和低碳钢生产中扮演着日益重要的角色。然而，炉料、能量输入和操作条件的波动性使得准确预测钢水温度和最终化学成分面临挑战。间歇性或延迟的测量限制了可用于及时预测的信息。本研究开发了一种可用性感知的历史反馈学习框架，用于预测电弧炉终点温度以及十二种化学元素的最终浓度。八个工业数据源被整合为三种逐步丰富化的预测特征表示，包含19个静态特征、39个时序特征和47个历史信息特征。历史结果仅在满足假设的60分钟测量发布延迟的条件下才被纳入。基于19,738炉温度数据和3,341炉化学成分数据，对十二种经过调优的回归算法进行了训练与评估。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种可用性感知的历史反馈学习框架，在考虑60分钟测量延迟的约束下，将多源工业数据整合为逐步丰富的特征表示，显著提升了电弧炉终点温度和十二种化学元素最终浓度的预测性能。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an availability-aware historical-feedback learning framework that incorporates historical outcomes only under a 60-minute measurement-release delay, integrating eight industrial data sources into progressively enriched feature representations to improve prediction of electric arc furnace endpoint temperature and the final concentrations of twelve chemical elements.
